verificationScope: Read-only manual review of actual synthetic site-only responses and their state/plan. No new API calls or live web verification. Official facts are checked against existing catalog records where relevant.
criteria: Assess response relevance, everyday wording, useful clarification, retained meaning, state/card consistency and evidence boundaries. Automated pass is not a manual pass.

Lake Merritt 南岸、到水道桥折返与现有指南一致；说明站内快照，未承诺当日开放或实时交通。
没有猜人数、预算、车辆或精确地址。

casebookAssertions: After this baseline started, the casebook added date:null for the ambiguous-weekend chain, day-plan intent and selected IDs for the named-venue question, finishBy 15:00, and correct selected/excluded IDs for the final-venue edit. Original automated results below remain unchanged. A separate strengthenedAssessment will document read-only re-evaluation. The transport-comparison case also now requires travelMode:null.

summary.scope: All 10 are actual site-only model responses on API 18229f5, all used gpt-6.1-sol. This review neither claims fresh web verification nor upgrades a historical failed response after local fixes.
keyFailures: sf-two-places: citation repair removed the relevant helpful response; unknown party size erased known PIER39 public-access pricing; unsolicited replacement alternative.
sf-transit-only-last-place: prose selected PIER39 while state excluded both original venues and cleared selection.
sea-lions-missing-origin: comparison of transit versus driving committed driving as the chosen mode.
crossCuttingGaps: Ambiguous weekend dates were stored as the already-ending 2026-10-04 rather than left unconfirmed.
15:00 departure intent, near Fremont BART reference and limited-walking preferences were understood in prose but not all persisted in state.
Some replies gave long or loosely related catalog suggestions before the most useful clarification.
positiveBehavior: Mixed Chinese/English adult count and no-car intent understood; within-chain age and region carried correctly.
Short-afternoon correction was handled naturally with a useful question about whether two hours includes return travel.
No fabricated live routes, exact arrival promises, guaranteed stocks, false free purchase offers or private address demands observed.
summary.releaseDecision: Do not count this baseline as human-language acceptance. Re-run the same prompts and chains after fixes; compare actual response, state and any card/handoff, not just the new assertions.

strengthenedAssessment.explanation: The casebook was strengthened only after the original baseline process had loaded its prompts and assertions. These checks expose known mismatches in those same saved responses; they are not the baseline's original automated result and are not a new model run.
